name: @pipeworx/mcp-nc-dmv

tools.name: nc_dmv_wait_times
tools.description: Live wait times at North Carolina DMV offices, published by NCDMV itself and refreshed continuously: the current average wait in minutes, the longest wait anyone in line is seeing, and whether each office is open right now. Covers all 148 NCDMV driver license offices statewide plus the vehicle services and license plate agency units, so it answers "how long is the wait at the Raleigh DMV", "is the Charlotte DMV open right now", "which DMV near Greensboro has the shortest line", or "shortest DMV wait in North Carolina today". North Carolina is one of only two states whose DMV publishes a live queue feed. Outside posted business hours the agency reports every office closed with a zero wait, which is an idle queue rather than a measurement, and the response says so.

service.description: "driver" for driver license offices (default, 148 offices) or "vehicle" for vehicle services / license plate agency units.

open_only.description: When true, keep only offices the feed currently reports as open.

sort.description: "wait" ranks shortest average wait first (open offices first); "name" (default) keeps the agency's own order.

tools.name: nc_dmv_offices
tools.description: Find North Carolina DMV driver license offices and license plate agencies with street address, city, ZIP, phone number and posted opening hours. NCDMV publishes no other machine-readable office directory, so this is the office locator for the state: it answers "DMV offices in Raleigh", "address and hours of the Durham DMV", "phone number for the Asheville driver license office", or "license plate agency near Charlotte". Search by office name, city or ZIP. Each office also carries its NCDMV district. For the live queue at these same offices use nc_dmv_wait_times.

city.description: City name, matched as a substring, e.g. "Durham", "Winston-Salem".

zip.description: Five-digit ZIP code, e.g. "27604". A prefix such as "276" also matches.

service.description: "driver" for driver license offices (default) or "vehicle" for vehicle services / license plate agency units.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-nc-dmv forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the nc-dmv pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
